name: Enhanced Marching Cubes
definition: A 3D visualization algorithm that modifies the standard Marching Cubes lookup table to cover large holes in the 3D visualization model, resulting in a smooth and solid surface with more faces and points.
summary: Enhanced Marching Cubes resolves topological ambiguities in 3D models by adding 20 specific rules to the standard algorithm, using bilinear interpolation to produce smooth, solid surfaces without holes.
